channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Cultural unity on display on Day 2 of Assam Tea Employees Association conference
item.description: The second day witnessed vibrant cultural processions, tributes, calls for unity & workers’ welfare.

item.title: Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia takes charge as IAF Eastern Air Command chief
item.description: Air Marshal Walia succeeds Air Marshal Surat Singh, who superannuated on January 31, after 39 years of distinguished service

item.title: Budget 2026–27 reform-oriented, big win for Assam, Northeast: CM Sarma
item.description: The Chief Minister added that Budget’s skilling push aligns with Assam’s plan to become a trusted hub in healthcare & AI sectors

item.title: Made-in-Assam robots, MRI: Assam CM charts tech-driven healthcare future
item.description: Indigenous robotic surgery prototypes promise global-grade performance at one-fifth the cost, Sarma tells medical community

item.title: Budget 2026 to strengthen agriculture, reduce climate-related risks: Tea planters
item.description: The Finance Minister extended the Rs 1,000 crore PMCSPY for another year to improve welfare of tea workers, focusing on women and children in Assam and West Bengal.

item.title: Industry bodies welcome Union Budget 2026-27, see major boost for Assam & NE
item.description: A 47% increase in DoNER funding to Rs 5,915 crore is expected to strengthen infrastructure and drive social and economic growth across the Northeast.

item.title: Meghalaya NGO opposes border fencing, fears loss of land to Bangladesh
item.description: The Coordination Committee for International Border (CCIB) said if the fence is erected 150 yards away from the Zero Line, the landowners would be deprived of their land.

item.title: Budget 2026-27 reworks import duties: Major relief for health sector
item.description: Items like imported low-cost umbrellas, ATMs/cash dispensers, coffee roasting, brewing or vending machines are some of the items, which are going to be costlier

item.title: Assam govt announces Rs 50 Cr grant to preserve Darrang koch dynasty heritage
item.description: Assam CM Sarma also unveiled a 37-foot-high statue of 8th century Koch king, Krishna Narayan in Darrang

item.title: Budget earmarks Rs 500 Cr under DoNER for ULFA (pro-talks) rehab in Assam
item.description: The special package falls under DoNER, which received an allocation of Rs 6,812.3 crore
